title: calcitrapa iberica
intro: Calcitrapa iberica, commonly known as Iberian rocket, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Calcitrapa iberica include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glucosinolates, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
